desc: Write brute-force checker for all N<=8 and all X,Y<=N.
Run the brute-force checker and determine whether the ordered residue-sequence invariant is complete.
Finalize and validate the O(N) residue-invariant solution on samples and edge cases.
Validate the final solution on edge cases: X=Y, X+Y>N, all zeros/ones, N=1, X=1 or Y=1, and performance for N=5e5.
